name: Methylene blue
effects: Reversible MAOI-A — dangerous with serotonergic drugs

halfLifeSource: FDA label for PROVAYBLUE (methylene blue), Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacokinetics — t½ ≈ 24 hours
halfLifeNotes: Intravenous administration; the label's 24-hour value supersedes the shorter 5–6.5 h figure in secondary sources, and half-life is unchanged in mild-to-moderate renal impairment.
